category_name: The scorn of ascribing things to evil omens
title: The scorn of ascribing things to evil omens - Hisn al-Muslim 94
arabic: اللّهُـمَّ لا طَيْـرَ إِلاّ طَيْـرُك، وَلا خَـيْرَ إِلاّ خَـيْرُك، وَلا إِلهَ غَيْـرُك
transliteration: Allāhumma lā ṭayra illā ṭayruk, wa lā khayra illā khayruk, wa lā ilāha ghayruk.
translation: O Allah there is no portent other than Your portent, no goodness other than Your goodness, and none worthy of worship other than You.
tags: The scorn of ascribing things to evil omens
